data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin name ‘Maria’, which comes from the Hebrew name ‘Miriam’. The suffix ‘-ella’ means ‘little’. This name carries the meaning of ‘Mary of Helper’ or ‘Mary the Helper’. The name Marzella carries the meaning “Mary of Helper” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Marzella usually hope their child will grow to embody mary of helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Μαρτσέλα
in_greek.long_meaning: Μαρτσέλα είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα που προέρχεται από την ιταλική γλώσσα και σημαίνει κυρία, δεσποίνη. Το όνομα προέρχεται από το εβραϊκό όνομα מרים και το λατινικό όνομα Margarita. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Μαρτσέλα χρησιμοποιείται ως ένδειξη σεβασμού για μια ευγενή και υψηλόβαθμη γυναίκα.

in_latin.name: Marzella
in_latin.long_meaning: Marzella is a Christian name derived from Italian, meaning lady or mistress. The name originates from the Hebrew name מרים and the Latin name Margarita. In Christian tradition, Marzella is used as a term of respect for a noble and high-ranking woman, reflecting her dignity and honor.

in_english.name: Marzella
in_english.meaning: Marzella means lady or mistress, a title of respect
in_english.long_meaning: Marzella is a Christian name of Italian origin, meaning lady or mistress. It is derived from the Hebrew name מרים (Miryam), meaning bitter, and the Latin name Margarita, meaning pearl. The name Marzella has been used in Christian tradition to signify a woman of nobility, dignity, and honor. It reflects the virtues of kindness, compassion, and generosity. In modern times, Marzella remains a popular name across Christian cultures, symbolizing strength and elegance.
